description.value: Xiang Yuan Qiao (Bridge Rice Noodle) is a Chinese restaurant located in Richmond's Number 3 Road corridor, a dense commercial area popular with cyclists exploring the city's extensive bike network. The Facebook page subtitle suggests a specialty in rice noodle dishes, typical of southern Chinese cuisine. Richmond's flat terrain and bike-friendly infrastructure make this a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through the area.
